message: Prepare the next harder low-poly authoring benchmark reference. INITIAL TURN READ-ONLY: inspect available Blender/Python tools and propose a concise deterministic scene and seven edit constraints. Do not write files, render, install software, start servers or spawn descendants until a separate bounded permit. Correlation: 96c0dc73bd37ecb882c68bceb114464db22bcb63358d52ec77627f770951b003. Work only here in /workspace/scratch/0190a8c72f8a/aperture-recovery-20261002; later exclusive output benchmarks/crane-reference-20261003. The cottage comparison and compatible PCSS repair have completed native validation; the user wants increasing geometry, lighting, articulation and procedural-edit complexity as gaps close. Create an engine-neutral low-poly industrial courtyard reference using an articulated crane with connected hydraulic cylinder, hanging hook/load and cable, curved hollow pipe, an arched wall opening, layered platform and a few simple props. Favor reproducible procedural geometry, no downloaded assets, textures or ornate details. Plan three fixed camera views and seven meaningful parameter edits with precise expected geometric relationships; include articulation, opening width, pipe radius and assembly movement. Reference deliverables will be a deterministic Blender builder, real scene/GLB, reference PNG views, numeric scene/constraint manifest and shared author brief. Keep engine sources and old evidence untouched; no browser use is needed. Authors will later receive equal frozen visual/reference constraints, not the builder source. No formal scoring or physical-simulation claims. Report useful results right away, before scratch notes. If work remains, use collaboration.send_message; otherwise return the result. Keep your status report short; complete the research and deliverable at the depth the task requires. If authorization is missing, or the reviewer denies an action for that reason, pause and report the exact action, target, and blocker to me. If I send <transcript_evidence> that authorizes that action and target, proceed; if already denied, retry the same tool call once. Don’t add the evidence to tool arguments. If the evidence is insufficient or the retry is denied, stop and report back. If you delegate that action, forward the block unchanged.
